english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for arguing that a claim or argument is false or incorrect.
Use this when actively arguing against what another person has said.
Use this when counter means to contradict or argue against what someone has said.

examples.english: This new evidence is enough to refute his claim.
examples.traditional: 呢份新證據足以反駁佢嘅講法。

examples.english: They immediately contradict what the other person says.
examples.traditional: 佢即刻反駁對方嘅講法。
